parts.heading: Normally open (NO)
parts.alt: Input wiring diagram: normally open (NO) contact between COM and INx. Short - Alarm, Open - Restore.

parts.heading: Normally closed (NC)
parts.alt: Input wiring diagram: normally closed (NC) contact between COM and INx. Short - Restore, Open - Alarm.

parts.heading: Normally open with 10k end-of-line resistor (EOL10k)
parts.alt: Input wiring diagram: NO contact with a 10 k end of line resistor in parallel between COM and INx (EOL10k). Short - Alarm, Open - Alarm, 10k - Restore.

parts.heading: Normally closed with 10k end-of-line resistor (EOL10k)
parts.alt: Input wiring diagram: NC contact in series with a 10 k end of line resistor between COM and INx (EOL10k). Short - Alarm, Open - Alarm, 10k - Restore.
